skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 5 combo strikes for 50% ATK DMG each, and grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 5 combo strikes for 56% ATK DMG each, and grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 35% of own HP).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. At the start of battle, grants all allies 50% Shield Rate for 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. At the start of battle, grants all allies 60% Shield Rate for 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. At the start of battle, grants all allies 70% Shield Rate for 2 turns.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
